definitions.full: H1916. hadom הֲדֹם noun masculine stool, footstool , always joined with רַגְלַיִם ; only in poetry and late writings, (properly something cast down, low ) — ׳ה absolute Psa 110:1 (or construct before לְ , compare Ges § 130 , 1); construct Lam 2:1 + 4t. — footstool , never literal, usually of ׳י Isa 66:1 ה וְהָאָרֶץ כִּסְאִי ׳הַשָּׁמַיִם רַגְלַי ; elsewhere with reference to sanctuary ׳ה רַגְלָיו (compare רַגְלַי מְקוֺם 60:13 ) Lam 2:1 , or perhaps of ark (as place on which God rests) Psa 99:5 ; 132:7 , אֱלֹהֵינוּ בְּרִיתיֿ לַאֲרוֺן מְנוּחָה ׳בֵּית ׳וְלַה רַגְלֵי 1Chr 28:2 ; of conquest of enemies of Messianic king by Yahweh's agency לְרַגְלֶיךָ הֲדֹם אֹיְבֶיךָ אָשִׁית Psa 110:1 .
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to stamp upon;

occurrences.englishText: Then David the king stood up on his feet, and said, “Hear me, my brothers, and my people! As for me, it was in my heart to build a house of rest for the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and for the footstool of our God; and I had prepared for the building.
Yahweh says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
“We will go into his dwelling place.
How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger!
